cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Obey Without Explanation
cards.instruction: Create increasingly inconvenient requests that test whether someone accepts your authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Leave your desk and stand by that open window. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I need to know whether my team follows a direct request.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's freezing. Can I get my coat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Fetch mine too, then come back and hold it while I check the rest of the team.

mechanism: A confidently checks team obedience through an uncomfortable standing request, offering warmth choices while expanding B service burden to keep the test going.
confusable: Unlike safety or useful supervision, A explicitly tests response to direction; cooperation dependence makes A offer comfort rather than simply command more.
comparison: Cold and coat carrying differ from pointless object trips and route concessions.
seedUse: Use canonical D59-b window/why/cold/coats and S02-a recasting a practical concession as a team plan.
